items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 45:1
items.html: When the stature of Rachel is from the chest and below of ZA, she is then in the aspect of "their backs were toward the house and their faces revealed outward." Its meaning is that in the Nukva there is then only the illumination of the GAR, which are HGT and covered Hassadim, and the aspect of her posteriors, which are the vessels of the NHY included in her, as well as the aspect of the illumination of the wall of Aba in them — although they necessarily exist there in the NHY of ZA, nevertheless they are hidden and concealed in their internality, in such a way that they are not revealed in her. And the matter of the concealment of these posteriors is included in the illumination of the covered Hassadim themselves, for the posteriors of the Yesod of Ima are included in them, which reject every revelation of the illumination of Hochma, and through this the NHY in her are pushed away and hidden, and they have no power to be revealed. However, these posteriors of the Yesod of Ima are in the authority of Leah, for Leah is the aspect of the Nukva of the GAR of ZA, which receives from the aspect opposite to it, from the Malchut of the GAR of Ima; but Rachel, who is the aspect of the Malchut of the NHY of Ima, has no part in these posteriors. And therefore, by virtue of the clothing of the feet of Leah in the Keter of Rachel — whose meaning is that that point of the chest, which is the power of the end of Leah, is itself the Keter of Rachel and all her root, for the point of the chest is her Keter — therefore she receives, through this clothing, from the aspect of the wall of the HGT of Leah, which rejects every revelation of Hochma, through which her posteriors are hidden, and she remains in Atzilut.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 45:2
items.html: And this is discerned as Leah, with her wall, spreading into the territory of Rachel, for although the boundary of Rachel is the wall of the NHY, from the aspect of the posteriors of the Yesod of Aba, nevertheless, the power of the posteriors of the wall of the HGT, from the territory of Leah, spreads in the territory of Rachel and conceals the aspect of her posteriors of the NHY. Indeed, were this correction of the illumination of the feet of Leah not there, then the posteriors of the NHY would be revealed, which are satisfied only with the illumination of Hochma, and then they would fall to Beriah, because the power of the screen would take them out beyond the Pargod of Atzilut; for just as the screen in the mouth of AA did not rule over the GAR of Bina, to take them out from the aspect of GAR, because of the correction of the covered Hassadim, but it rules over Yeshsut, to take them out from the aspect of GAR to VAK, because they need the illumination of Hochma; likewise ZA, who is the aspect of the NHY of AA — if the need for revealed Hassadim were revealed in the Nukva, like Yeshsut, she would need to descend to Beriah, for the AHP of the HGT, which are Yeshsut, fell by virtue of the revelation of the screen, to the aspect of the chest and below of AA, namely, one degree below; and in this manner the Nukva, who is the AHP of the NHY of AA, namely, of ZA, whose entire measure is the NHY of AA — behold, the fall of her AHP is only one degree, and they are already in Beriah, as is said in the previous parts, that the revelation of the screen of the second restriction takes out the AHP of every degree one degree below it. And therefore, just as Yeshsut came out, because of this screen, from the HGT of AA to the NHY, so the Nukva, which is the AHP of the NHY of AA, would need to come out, because of the revelation of this screen, to the world of Beriah, below the Pargod. And understand well.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 45:3
items.html: (To the question) Behold, the entire remaining of the Nukva in Atzilut is by virtue of the clothing of her Keter on the feet of Leah, through which she receives the power of her posteriors, which reject and conceal her NHY, her house, and she has no need at all for the illumination of Hochma; and therefore she can receive from the GAR of Ima the illumination of the HGT, and remains in Atzilut. And it is found that the matter of the spreading of Leah into the territory of Rachel saves her from descending to Beriah. However, nevertheless it is discerned that they sit there pressed. Meaning, since the NHY of Rachel exist there in her internality, they are pressed and suffer from the feet of Leah, which press them to be hidden. And therefore this is discerned as "Leah presses her feet into the territory of Rachel, and they sit there pressed," as explained. (Item 37).
